name: forgeline-cloud
description: forgeline Cloud: the Cloudflare Worker that devices running forgeline-agent dial into (docs/cloud-agent.md)

scripts.build: wrangler deploy --dry-run --env dev --outdir .wrangler/dry-run/dev && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env prod --outdir .wrangler/dry-run/prod
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
